description.value:
Gale Palm. You clap your hands together and unleash a focused gale in a 15-foot cone. Creatures in the area must succeed at a Fortitude save or be pushed back 10 feet and become off-guard until the end of your next turn (critical failure: pushed 20 feet and knocked prone).

The cone is strong enough to extinguish unprotected flames and to scatter small unattended objects (clouds of dust, kunai mid-flight) in its path.

Heightened (3rd) The cone increases to 30 feet and the push distance to 15/25 feet.
